messages:
Maya: Noticing a weird spike for EU customers starting ~10:05 UTC. Many requests returned 403, some 200s but outputs look garbled with spaces inserted and abrupt truncation. Example req: req_eu_91a.
Ben: Can you paste one raw response + headers (sanitized)? Which logical model and region header?
Maya: Hitting /v1/generate model="rdw-13b" with Region: eu-west-2. Sanitized payload: 
```
{"request_id":"req_eu_91a","model":"rdw-13b","status":200,"output":"Th is a te st res ult ... <EOS>"}
```
Headers:
```
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Region: eu-west-2
X-Client-Id: acme-service
```
Ben: Thanks. I'm seeing our logs show a failover executed at 10:04:58 UTC for eu-west-2 -> eu-backup-legacy due to node OOM. Tagging Lina (routing) and Marco (ML).
deploy-bot: automatic failover triggered: eu-west-2 -> eu-backup-legacy at 2025-03-19T10:04:58Z (policy=memory-pressure).
Lina: Confirmed. The backup pool runs a legacy binary: rdw-13b-oldtok-v2-int8. That variant uses a different tokenizer merges file and an older vocab mapping.
Marco: int8 quant + tokenizer mismatch would explain inserted spaces and shorter outputs (early EOS). The 403s might be separate: some internal auth checks were failing when routing through the backup pool because the service account audience requirement differs on that pool (weird, will check).
Maya: The confusing part: responses still show model="rdw-13b" which made us think we were on the same binary. Any way to see the physical variant in responses?
Lina: Currently we only expose logical model. That's by design to avoid churn during rolling updates, but in failover cases it's problematic. We'll add a header with the physical variant id for debugging.
Marco: Quick repro note for eng: tokenization diff between rdw-13b-oldtok-v2-int8 and rdw-13b-stable-202502 produces these symptoms: inserted spaces on certain byte sequences and earlier <EOS> due to quantized logits.
Ben: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Pin to model_version=rdw-13b-stable-202502 in your request body to avoid routing to backup variant. 2) Temporarily set Region: us-east-1 to bypass the EU pools while we remediate. Which would you prefer?
Maya: We'll try the model_version pin first. Can you give the exact curl?
Lina: Use this (example):
```
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Region: eu-west-2" \
  -d '{"model":"rdw-13b","model_version":"rdw-13b-stable-202502","input":"Explain: ..."}'
```
That forces the stable binary.
Maya: Pinned and re-ran. Results look normal, no extra spaces and no truncation. 403s stopped for those same request IDs. Thanks.
Marco: Good. For the auth failures: infra-bot, can you confirm if the backup pool enforces an additional audience claim or different token verifier config?
infra-bot: Checking. eu-backup-legacy has a stale verifier config that expects audience="rdw-service-eu-legacy" for internal service tokens. We will sync verifier configs to accept current audience and add a rolling redeploy to replace the legacy binaries.
Lina: Short-term routing change: disabling automated failover to eu-backup-legacy until we ensure tokenization compatibility and auth config parity. We'll also push X-physical-variant and X-tokenizer-version headers to the response in the next deploy.
Marco: Repro steps for eng-runtime to validate and test:
- 1) Use chaos tool to simulate memory pressure on eu-primary pool -> should trigger failover.
- 2) Send a batch of generation requests with a fixed prompt and note tokenization artifacts and latency.
- 3) Collect logs: request_id, route_id, physical_variant, tokenizer_version, verifier_audience, status_code.
Example internal log query (sanitized):
```
GET /internal/logs?request_id=req_eu_91a&fields=route_id,physical_variant,tokenizer_version,verifier_audience,status_code
```
Marco: Compare outputs between physical variants rdw-13b-oldtok-v2-int8 and rdw-13b-stable-202502 to confirm regressions.
Ben: Ops actions: disabled auto-failover to eu-backup-legacy at 10:22 UTC and queued redeploy of eu-backup-legacy with updated tokenizer & verifier.
deploy-bot: Redeploy job #rg-912 queued -> eu-backup-legacy at 2025-03-19T10:23:12Z.
Maya: Appreciate the quick response. One request: can you add X-physical-variant to responses so we can detect silent substitutions in future?
Lina: Yes — we'll add X-physical-variant and X-tokenizer-version headers. We'll also add a notice in the API docs about model_version pinning for critical paths.
Ben: Marking this as escalated to eng-runtime + eng-ml for a permanent fix. I'll follow up in this thread with the postmortem link once ready.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
